LESSON: CROP PEST AND DISEASE CONTROL

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Crop Pest and Disease Control
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Crop Pest and Disease Control, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 8 AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How can we identify vegetable crops attacked by pests and diseases? 2. How can we control pests and diseases in crops?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Crop Pest and Disease Control together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
• Unity: The learner works in collaboration with peers in groups to control diseases on vegetables using various methods.

• Responsibility: The learner takes care of vegetables by controlling pests and diseases.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Environmental education and climate change: The learner avoids polluting the environment by appropriately using pesticides to control

pests and diseases in vegetables.

19

● Disaster risk reduction: The learner mitigates the risk of food insecurity by effectively controlling pests and diseases in vegetable

production.

Link to other subjects:

● Learners relate control of pests and diseases in crops to farming for economic activities learnt in social studies.

Suggested Learning Resources:

● Samples of crop materials affected by crop pests and diseases

● Field with growing vegetable crops.

● Sign Language Dictionary

● Digital devices

● Magnifying lenses

● Hand lens

● Charts displaying various crop pests and vegetable crops with symptoms of different diseases.

● Ash
